name: <game>
title: Call of Duty: <Title> (<ENGINE>)
note: Template (profiles/_template): copy to profiles/<game>/, replace every <...>, delete the *_note keys you do not need. profiles/iw6 (Ghosts) and profiles/bo4 are complete examples. This machine's paths (the exe, working folders, install, Ghidra project) go in profile.local.json beside it (git-ignored; shape: profile.local.example.json), merged over this file.
transcriber_note: "asm": tables from the loaders' machine code (the machine-code transcriber), for var-global loaders (varX = p; Load_X(flag)). Remove the key for loaders taking the struct as an argument, transcribed from Ghidra's C (the C transcriber, as BO4).

rva.load_stream: <Load_Stream(flag, dst, size): the most called function of the loaders>
rva.stream_init: <fills the block table and the block cursors, once per zone>
rva.insert_ptr: <reserves a slot for a resident (-2) asset>
rva.resolve_deref: <an asset back reference: reads the pointer at the place (IW6)>

asset_dispatch.note: the game's asset loop, when it goes through one dispatcher (var-global loaders)

stream.marker_inline: <the header value of an inline asset or pointer, e.g. 0xffffffffffffffff>
stream.backref_style: <t8: block << 60 | offset + 1; iw6: 0xFDFDFDF<block><offset + 1>; block32: block << 32 | offset + 1>

zone_load.note: what DB_LoadXFile does before the first asset, for the emulator (the zone format's prefix, or emulated)

crt_note: IAT thunks the emulator performs itself (their DLLs are not in the dump): rva -> memset/memcpy/...
